title: Otori Emu — 1920s Girl♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The Showa Commemorative Museum's gonna be so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm excited as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially since the museum can teach us all about the culture and events of the Showa period, which means this is the perfect way to prepare for our roles.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, since they have all sorts of different items on display, like tools that were actually used back then.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, thank goodness this museum's so close. Books and the internet help a little, but seeing those kinds of things for real should make things a lot easier for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Agreed!
We should try to experience as much as we can! From feeling how heavy those old telephone receivers are to appreciating the atmosphere of a room!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I looked up what they have and discovered that the exhibits are divided along different decades.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, we should focus on seeing as many exhibits as we can from the setting of the play.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Showa Commemorative Museum

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is so cool... It's like we've gone back in time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They appear to have turned a building from back then into a museum.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Apparently, it was originally an inn...
Now, each of the rooms contains a different exhibit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, look!
You can experience what daily life was like back in the Showa period in this room!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ooh! So everyone from “The Pomegranate” must've lived in rooms like these...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We can apparently even use all the old appliances. Wanna head in?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Pardon us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ready when you are, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! And action!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No good! I won't make the deadline at this rate! But my livelihood depends on it...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No, all this anxiety is just going to prevent me from coming up with good ideas. I should try to relax by having some tea...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Excuse me. Would you mind bringing some tea?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Right away, Sir!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are they doing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe they're improvising a conversation between a novelist feeling the pressure of a deadline and his housekeeper.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh geez... Cut it out, don't you realize that other people are also here...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow!
This room's full of old toys!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What a marvelous sight...!
Toys covering every inch of space!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
What are these ones...? Oh, they're all tin robots.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... So many. And they all have the same, bland look on their faces.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bland? I think they're all really cute.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, look! If you wind this one up...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! It can walk?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... More like waddle.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I find tin toys fascinating because of how they can move in a variety of ways despite their simple designs.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You look like you're having a lot of fun, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Find something interesting, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So... I just noticed all these funny-looking signs.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Funny-looking?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. I can read each letter, but I don't get what they mean.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like that one! Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Maerc Eci”? Is that what it says?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I believe that one's for ice cream.
Back then, they sometimes used to write Japanese to be read from right to left.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Th-This also news to me.
I was wondering what all these strange words meant...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. We're learning so many new things! This is so much fun☆ Oh, let's try going over there next!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Emu, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
That was a lot of fun! We got to see so much☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was nice how each exhibit was set up with an interactive element so that visitors get an immersive experience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, it was! I loved trying on all those Showa outfits♪ And they had sooo many, so choosing which ones to wear was also super fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That hat and one-piece dress looked really good on you. I'll send you that picture a little later.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Thanks, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And that outfit I picked out for you, Tsukasa. Wasn't it spectacular?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Spectacular? Hardly...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, was it not to your liking?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You made me dress up as a greengrocer! What does that have to do with the character I'll be playing?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, but it suited you really well.
You looked like the real thing when we took that picture of you at the vegetable stand exhibit...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She's right! You looked really good with a headband on♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Again, I'm supposed to be playing a magazine editor!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, keep your voice down.
This is so embarrassing... Everyone's looking at us now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... Why am I the one being chastised...?! If anything, that should be Rui...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, the next time we come here, I'm going to pick out a ridiculous outfit for you to wear! Call it payback!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I agree with Tsukasa. We should totally come here again sometime since we didn't have time to see everything!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'd also like to come back.
We really only went around to the exhibits from the years that our show's set in.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
They apparently have two more halls...
It'll be exciting to see how they differ from what we saw today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! So, to make sure that we come back here smiling, we'll need to give this show everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! We get to come back♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Let's do our absolute best during our next practice!
